announcements.headline: Eramet outlines its short- and medium-term operational and strategic roadmap
announcements.insight: This roadmap clarifies Eramet's pivot toward critical minerals (nickel, manganese) essential for the energy transition, directly addressing investor scrutiny on ESG and supply chain security amidst volatile commodity cycles.

announcements.headline: EBITDA rebound in H1 2026; execution of the funding plan underway, essential for the Group in H2
announcements.insight: This announcement signals a positive operational turnaround in the first half of 2026, which may support investor confidence. The mention of an ongoing funding plan execution suggests potential financial restructuring or liquidity management activities that could influence future capital structure.

announcements.headline: General Meeting on May 27th, 2026: approval of the resolution regarding the €500m capital increase
announcements.insight: The €500m capital increase signals a decisive move to bolster Eramet's balance sheet for its critical transition into battery metals and potential M&A activity in the strategic minerals sector.
